NHS-SEIZURE.title: NHS — What to do if someone has a seizure (fit)

SJA-SEIZURE.title: St John Ambulance — Seizure First Aid

ARC-SEIZURE.title: American Red Cross — Seizures: Causes, Symptoms, and Types

high_confidence_signals.signal: sudden loss of responsiveness with jerking or uncontrolled movements

nodes.description_ar: لا تحرك المصاب إلا إذا كان في خطر مباشر.
nodes.description_en: Do not move the person unless they are in immediate danger.

nodes.description_ar: استخدم منشفة ملفوفة أو وسادة إن توفرت.
nodes.description_en: Use a rolled towel or pillow if available.
Note when the seizure starts and ends.

nodes.title_ar: لا تمسكه ولا تضع شيئًا في فمه
nodes.title_en: Do not restrain them or put anything in their mouth.
nodes.description_ar: ابقَ معه وانتظر توقف التشنجات مع إبقاء المكان آمنًا.
nodes.description_en: Stay with them and keep the area safe while the seizure runs its course.

nodes.description_ar: اتصل إذا كانت أول نوبة، استمرت أكثر من 5 دقائق، تكررت دون استعادة الوعي، حدثت إصابة خطيرة، أو ظهرت صعوبة تنفس.
nodes.description_en: Call if this is the first seizure, it lasts more than 5 minutes, repeats without recovery, causes serious injury, or breathing is difficult.

nodes.question_ar: بعد توقف التشنجات: هل يتنفس بشكل طبيعي؟
nodes.question_en: After the seizure stops: is the person breathing normally?

nodes.title_en: Stay with them and reassure them until they recover.
nodes.description_ar: قد يشعر بالنعاس أو الارتباك بعد النوبة. لا تعطه طعامًا أو شرابًا حتى يتعافى تمامًا.
nodes.description_en: They may be drowsy or confused afterward. Do not give food or drink until they have fully recovered.

UNRESPONSIVE_BREATHING.reason_ar: النوبة توقفت، لكنه لا يستجيب ويتنفس بشكل طبيعي
UNRESPONSIVE_BREATHING.reason_en: The seizure stopped, but the person is unresponsive and breathing normally

CARDIAC_ARREST_CPR.reason_ar: بعد النوبة لا يتنفس بشكل طبيعي
CARDIAC_ARREST_CPR.reason_en: After the seizure, the person is not breathing normally

precedence_rules.rule: Protect the person from injury and allow the seizure to run its course; do not restrain them.
Do not put anything in the person's mouth.
Time the seizure and escalate if it lasts more than 5 minutes or meets other emergency criteria.

never_do.rule_ar: لا تضع أي شيء في فمه، حتى أصابعك
never_do.rule_en: Do not put anything in their mouth, including your fingers

never_do.rule_ar: لا تعطِه طعامًا أو شرابًا حتى يتعافى تمامًا
never_do.rule_en: Do not give food or drink until fully recovered

never_do.rule_ar: لا تحركه إلا إذا كان في خطر مباشر
never_do.rule_en: Do not move them unless they are in immediate danger

open_items: Verify emergency-service numbers per Iraqi region before release.
This MVP does not attempt to diagnose epilepsy or the cause of the seizure.
Febrile seizures in infants/children can be added later as a dedicated flow if needed.
